blocks.text: Hum parh chuke hain ke jis conductor mein current beh raha ho us ke gird magnetic field ban jati hai. Isi tarah agar magnetic field badle to us mein rakhe conductor mein current paida ho jata hai. Electromagnetism physics ka woh aham hissa hai jo yeh parhta hai ke electric charges aur magnetic fields aapas mein kaise asar (interact) karte hain.
1820 mein Hans Christian Oersted (kitab mein 'Orsted') ne maloom kiya ke bijli (electricity) aur magnetism aapas mein jure hue hain.

blocks.alt: Ek khara taar, jis par Current likha hai, gehrai mein dikhaye gaye hamwar card ke beech se oopar guzarta hai. Card par taar ke gird hum-markaz (concentric) daira-numa field lines hain jin ke teer oopar se dekhne par anticlockwise chalte hain. Card par do chhote compass rakhe hain, ek peeche daen aur ek aage baen, un ki suiyan dairon ke saath hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.1: Current se paida hone wali magnetic field ki simt (kitab ki Figure 10.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Taar mein current oopar ja raha hai. Daen haath ka angootha current ki simt mein rakh kar taar ko pakrein: ungliyan jis taraf mudti hain wahi field ki simt hai, yaani oopar se dekhne par anticlockwise. Compass ki sui (needle) hamesha daire ke saath, yaani field ki simt mein, ruk jati hai. Current ulta karein to suiyan bhi ulat jati hain.

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Magnetism ki shuruat lodestone se hui, jo qadeem Türkiye mein milne wala ek qudrati mineral (maadni patthar) hai. Lodestone, yani magnetite (Fe₃O₄), loha aur steel jaisi dhaaton ko khainchta hai aur Zameen ke magnetic poles ki seedh mein aa jata hai. Isi se compass ijad hua.

Electromagnetism aaj ki technology, jaise phones, computers aur medical aalaat, ke liye bohat zaroori hai. Is chapter mein hum electric fields, magnetic forces aur electromagnetic induction jaise bunyadi tasawwurat parhenge, aur dekhenge ke yeh usool qudrati waqiaat aur technology dono par kaise asar karte hain. In ki samajh se pata chalta hai ke electromagnetism hamari duniya par kaise asar karta hai aur nayi ijadat ko aage barhata hai.

blocks.caption: Bijli aur magnetism ke do rishte
rows: seedhe taar ke gird gol field lines (Fig. 10.1); Oersted ka compass
Badalti magnetic field current banati hai

blocks.prompt: Bijli ki line (power line) mein current shimal (north) ki taraf beh raha hai. Taar ke bilkul oopar magnetic field ki simt (direction) kya hogi (MCQ 10.1)?
blocks.explanation: Right-hand grip rule lagayein: daen haath ka angootha current ki simt, yani shimal ki taraf rakhein. Peeche se (shimal ki taraf dekhte hue) ungliyan clockwise mudti hain, is liye taar ke bilkul oopar ungliyan daen taraf, yani mashriq (east) ki taraf jati hain. Jawab (c) east hai. Taar ke neeche field maghrib (west) ki taraf hoti hai; isi liye Oersted ke tajurbe mein taar ke neeche rakhe compass ki sui maghrib ki taraf murti hai.

items: Current magnetic field banata hai, aur badalti magnetic field current banati hai; electromagnetism charges aur magnetic fields ka aapas ka asar parhta hai. Oersted (1820) ne bijli aur magnetism ka rishta dikhaya.
Qadeem Türkiye ka lodestone (magnetite, Fe₃O₄) loha aur steel khainchta hai aur compass ki bunyad bana.
